--add salesperson for cancelled trades
update [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades]
set [dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades].Salesperson = [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_SalesOrgList].SalesPersonFullName
from [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades] 
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_SalesOrgList] ON [dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades].[sales_person_id] = [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_SalesOrgList].SalesPersonUserId
WHERE [dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades].Salesperson IS NULL

--add userTypeCode for cancelled trades
update [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades]
set [dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades].userTypeCode = [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_UsersUserTypes].userTypeCode
from [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades] 
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_UsersUserTypes] ON [dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades].[cancelled_by_id] = [dbo].[tbl_DRSCDS_UsersUserTypes].UserId

--add office for cancelled trades
update [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades]
set office = CASE WHEN userTypeCode IN('BACKOFF ','MIDOFF') THEN 'MO' WHEN userTypeCode IN('SALEASST','SALES','TRADASST','TRADER') THEN 'FO' ELSE 'N/A' END
from [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades]

update [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_Trades]
set [INVENTORY_BR_CODE] = ltrim(rtrim(CASE WHEN (CHARINDEX('-',inventory) = 5 OR CHARINDEX('-',inventory) = 6 ) THEN SUBSTRING(inventory, 1, CHARINDEX('-',inventory)-1) ELSE SUBSTRING(inventory, CHARINDEX('-',inventory)+1, LEN(inventory)) END))

UPDATE a
SET
a.[WELLS_ENTITY_NAME] = b.[WELLS_ENTITY_NAME],
a.[WELLS_ENTITY_CODE] = b.[WELLS_ENTITY_CODE],
a.[TRADING_UNIT_NAME] = b.[TRADING_UNIT_NAME],
a.[TRADING_UNIT_ID] = b.[TRADING_UNIT_ID],
a.[DESK_NAME] = b.[DESK_NAME],
a.[ACCOUNTING_UNIT] = b.[ACCOUNTING_UNIT]
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_Trades] a
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tbl_IM_GENERIC_ALLSTATUS b
ON a.INVENTORY_BR_CODE = b.INVENTORY_NAME
WHERE b.[STATUS] = 'Active' 
AND b.SYSTEM_OF_RECORD IN ('Broadridge', 'GMI')

DELETE 
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades_EconomicType]


INSERT INTO [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades_EconomicType
SELECT DISTINCT      
a.catalyst_trade_number AS catalyst_cancelled_trade_number, 
a.total_cash AS total_cash_cancelled, 
b.catalyst_trade_number AS catalyst_corrected_trade_number,
b.total_cash AS total_cash_corrected, 
CAST(a.total_cash AS FLOAT) - CAST(b.total_cash AS FLOAT) AS EconDiff,
--case when CAST(dbo.tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct.total_cash AS float) - CAST(tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct_1.total_cash AS float) = 0 then 'Non-Economic' when CAST(dbo.tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct.total_cash AS float) - CAST(tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct_1.total_cash AS float) <> 0 then 'Economic' end as Econ_Type
CASE WHEN a.cancel_reason IN (SELECT cancel_reason FROM tbl_Catalyst_EconomicStatusCancelReasons WHERE [economic status] = 'Economic') THEN 'Economic' ELSE 'Non-Economic' END AS Econ_Type,
a.cancel_reason
FROM [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct a
INNER JOIN [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct AS b
ON a.catalyst_trade_number = b.prev_trade_number
WHERE a.trade_status = 'CNCL' AND a.CancelType = 'CXLCOR'
ORDER BY Econ_Type


UPDATE a
SET 
a.EconDiff = b.EconDiff,
a.Econ_Type = b.Econ_Type,
a.catalyst_corrected_trade_number = b.catalyst_corrected_trade_number,
a.corrected_total_cash = b.total_cash_corrected
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades] a
INNER JOIN dbo.tbl_catalyst_cancelled_trades_EconomicType b
ON a.[catalyst_trade_number] = b.[catalyst_cancelled_trade_number]


UPDATE a 
SET 
a.Econ_Type = 'Economic'
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_Trades] a
WHERE Econ_Type IS NULL --and total_cash = '0'
	AND cancel_reason IN (SELECT cancel_reason FROM tbl_Catalyst_EconomicStatusCancelReasons WHERE [economic status] = 'Economic')

UPDATE a 
SET 
a.Econ_Type = 'Non-Economic'
FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_catalyst_cancelled_Trades] a
WHERE Econ_Type IS NULL --and total_cash <> '0'
	AND (cancel_reason IN (SELECT cancel_reason FROM tbl_Catalyst_EconomicStatusCancelReasons WHERE [economic status] = 'Non-Economic')
		OR cancel_reason IS NULL OR cancel_reason = '')
